archetypes.name: shell-portability
archetypes.rationale: The core scripting fix targets Bash 3.2 empty-array expansion; verify the guard pattern is correct and complete across all array expansions in render-final-summary.sh.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the two `${print_arg[@]+"${print_arg[@]}"}` guard substitutions introduced in `skills/design/scripts/render-final-summary.sh` around lines 295-298 of the diff. Verify the guard idiom matches the `BASH_AUTHORING.md` §3 canonical form exactly. Check whether any other array variables in the same file (e.g. `COST_ARGS`, `_rr_args`, or any other `${arr[@]}` expansions) could also be empty under `set -euo pipefail` on Bash 3.2 and are missing the same guard. Confirm the fix applies to both the `COST_ARGS`-empty branch and the `COST_ARGS`-non-empty branch inside `invoke_render()`. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-contract-consistency
archetypes.rationale: Several doc files were updated to reflect cross-skill artifact semantics; verify no internal contradictions or orphaned references remain across the updated docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Cross-check the updated prose in `docs/run-logs.md` (the `### final-summary.md` block), `skills/implement/scripts/write-final-report.md`, `scripts/token-report.md`, and `scripts/token-cost.md` for internal consistency. Specifically: the outcome enumeration (`bailed*`, `stalled`, `cancelled-*`, `failed-*`) must be stated identically across all files that mention it; the link targets in `docs/run-logs.md` (pointing to `write-final-report.md` and `render-final-summary.sh`) must use correct relative paths; and the HTML-entity-encoded angle brackets (`<`, `>`) in the new `docs/run-logs.md` prose must render correctly as literal `<>` in the committed Markdown. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
